mapper.sql: c.id AS comment_id, c.parent_id AS parent_id, (c.status = 'ACTIVE') AS active, c.member_id AS author_id, m.nickname AS author_nickname, c.content AS content, c.created_at AS created_at, c.updated_at AS updated_at
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM community_comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.post_id = #{postId} AND c.parent_id IS NULL AND (c.status = 'ACTIVE' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM community_comment r WHERE r.parent_id = c.id AND r.status = 'ACTIVE')) ORDER BY c.id ASC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT
FROM community_comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.status = 'ACTIVE' AND c.parent_id IN #{id} ORDER BY c.id ASC

SELECT
FROM community_comment c JOIN member m ON m.id = c.member_id WHERE c.id = #{commentId}
